basic_profile.bio: Based in the UK, I've been a Reddit user for over a decade and an avid Etsy seller specializing in handcrafted jewelry. I have a deep interest in geopolitics, particularly how it affects trade and small businesses like mine. Outside of crafting, I enjoy hiking the English countryside and have a keen interest in cryptocurrency. Typically, you'll find me online in the evenings after my day job as a freelance graphic designer. I am married and enjoy spending weekends exploring new food spots with my partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having a background in graphic design and running my own Etsy shop for several years, I have accumulated a wealth of knowledge in e-commerce, international trade regulations, and digital marketing. My understanding of cryptocurrency stems from self-study and active participation in related forums.
